title: The impact of labeling automotive AI as “trustworthy” or “reliable” on user evaluation and technology acceptance
benchmark_measurement: This paper does not measure any aspect of faith or religion. It explores user perceptions and acceptance of automotive AI when labeled as 'trustworthy' versus 'reliable'.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion or faith, as its focus is on user perceptions of automotive AI labeled as 'trustworthy' versus 'reliable'. The only connection to the topic is the authors' affiliation with a university department that includes the Study of Religion.
